title: DriveStack-VLA: Render-Teacher Alignment for BEV-Based DeepStack Vision-Language-Action Model
title_zh: DriveStack-VLA：面向 BEV-Based DeepStack Vision-Language-Action 模型的 Render-Teacher Alignment
abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action driving models convert a pretrained Vision-Language Model into a driving policy, allowing them to use world knowledge and follow language guidances. However, existing VLA driving models still lack driving-oriented spatial intelligence: their policies are mainly grounded on perspective image tokens and language priors, while precise motion planning requires metric geometry, top-down scene structure, and attention to safety-critical perceptual cues. This limitation makes current models vulnerable to weak visual geometry modeling and perceptual coverage in expert demonstrations. In this paper, we present DriveStack-VLA, a framework built upon a large VLM backbone. To strengthen the spatial grounding of VLA driving, we develop dual visual modeling components. We inject a Bird-Eye-View representation into the Large Language Model decoder through a DeepStack-style connection, and propose Render-Teacher Alignment to align the perceptual focus of real images with that of rasterized images. Furthermore, to bridge the gap in multimodal trajectory selection, we introduce a head-based self-critique module that ranks sampled trajectories and conditionally refines the best one. DriveStack-VLA achieves 91.6 PDMS on NAVSIMv1, 91.0 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 (with the human penalty filter enabled), and a driving score of 79.49 with a success rate of 56.36\% on the closed-loop Bench2Drive. More visualizations are available on our project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/drivestack-vla/.
abstract_zh: Vision-Language-Action（VLA）驾驶模型通常将预训练 Vision-Language Model 转化为驾驶策略，使其能够利用世界知识并遵循语言指令。然而，现有 VLA 驾驶模型仍缺乏面向驾驶的空间智能：其策略主要依赖透视图像 token 和语言先验，而精确运动规划需要度量几何、俯视场景结构以及对安全关键感知线索的关注。为此，论文提出 DriveStack-VLA，一个基于大型 VLM backbone 的自动驾驶框架。该方法通过双视觉建模增强 VLA 的空间 grounding：一方面以 DeepStack-style connection 将 Bird-Eye-View（BEV）表征注入 Large Language Model decoder；另一方面提出 Render-Teacher Alignment，使真实图像的感知关注与栅格化图像的关注模式对齐。此外，为弥合多模态轨迹选择差距，作者引入基于 head 的 self-critique 模块，对采样轨迹进行排序，并在必要时优化最佳轨迹。DriveStack-VLA 在 NAVSIMv1 上取得 91.6 PDMS，在启用 human penalty filter 的 NAVSIMv2 上取得 91.0 EPDMS，并在闭环 Bench2Drive 上达到 79.49 driving score 和 56.36% success rate。
key_points_zh: 指出现有 VLA driving models 过度依赖透视图像 token 与语言先验，缺少度量几何和 top-down 场景结构，难以满足安全关键的精确规划需求。
提出 DriveStack-VLA，在大型 VLM backbone 上通过 DeepStack-style connection 将 BEV representation 注入 LLM decoder，强化空间 grounding。
提出 Render-Teacher Alignment，将真实图像的感知关注与 rasterized images 的关注对齐，以提升对驾驶关键视觉线索的覆盖。
设计 head-based self-critique module，对多条采样轨迹进行排序，并在条件满足时细化最优轨迹，缓解多模态轨迹选择问题。
实验表现强：NAVSIMv1 达到 91.6 PDMS，NAVSIMv2 达到 91.0 EPDMS，Bench2Drive 闭环测试取得 79.49 driving score 和 56.36% success rate。

llm_assessment.comment: This paper meaningfully strengthens BEV-grounded VLA driving with render alignment and trajectory self-critique.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这篇工作通过BEV对齐和轨迹自检显著增强了具身驾驶中的空间 grounding。
